text:
Hello everyone ! 

I am married and I have a meeting next week at MH I think to receive my B1 visa. We uploaded all the documents online, then they told us to upload again and then we received an email saying we have an appointment at MH and we need to bring documents. 

They write something about section 3 but what does it mean ? What do I really need to bring ? It is so unclear, like always in this process .. Also will we have an interview or is it just handing over documents and they give me my B1? I need help please :) : **על התעודות המקוריות להיות מסודרות ומאורגנות בהתאם לסעיף 3 + צילום קריא וברור,**

**באם התעודות לא יוצגו כנדרש לא תתקיים פגישה.**
